rules.year_filter: local departure year in the flight tz; unknown tz falls back to UTC; year null = all time
rules.codes: aircraft_type, registration, seat and the reference icao_type compare trimmed and upper case; empty is unknown; family compares trimmed and lower case
rules.reference_duplicates: first entry wins (types by icao_type, facts by registration)
rules.total_types: distinct known aircraft_type over kept flights, including types absent from the reference
rules.manufacturers: flights per manufacturer of reference types; flights on unknown types count nowhere; percent = 100 * flights / flights on reference types, rounded half up; sorted flights desc then key asc
rules.type_minutes: sum of block_minutes, null counts as 0
rules.types_by_minutes_order: minutes desc, flights desc, icao_type asc
rules.types_by_distance_order: distance_km desc, flights desc, icao_type asc
rules.most_flown: first of types_by_flights, null when none
rules.tails: one row per known registration; icao_type and airline from the latest kept flight on that tail that has one; name from the fact; sorted flights desc then registration asc
rules.seat_position: seat trimmed, upper case, 1 to 3 digits then one letter; economy cabin of the family; other families, letters or shapes give null
rules.seat_positions: kept flights with a picked seat_position (counted as picked), else whose type is in the reference and whose seat has a position
rules.favourite_seat: most flown seat (trimmed, upper case, any shape), ties seat asc; null when none
rules.aged_aircraft: distinct registrations over kept flights with a fact that has delivered_at
rules.age_months: whole calendar months from delivered_at to as_of in UTC (a month counts once day and time of day are reached), 0 when delivered after as_of
rules.decades: UTC delivery year floored to 10, ascending, every decade from the first to the last, empty ones with 0
rules.median_age_months: sorted ages, element (n - 1) / 2 (lower middle for an even count); null when no aged aircraft
rules.newest_oldest: latest and earliest delivered_at, ties registration asc; null when no aged aircraft
